Results.ReviewText:
Use caution with small parts if you are self-assembling; there are very few spares. (We DIY’d it carefully and didn’t lose any parts through the deck slats.)

Assembly took about 90 mins-2 hours as we followed directions to the letter, including leak test. Directions were complete and concise with clear illustrations. 

We’ve used our new grill a half-dozen times since and love it! Even, quick heating and easy to clean. I have since purchased several Weber accessories including the iGrill thermometer, a new cover, and replacement aluminum drip pans (which make disposing of grease drippings easy).

Great purchase and strongly recommended!!
Results.Title: Spirit II E310 is a winner!!

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
